messages:
emma: Hey team — can we give Growth team Pendo access for onboarding funnel analysis? They want session replay and page-level analytics. Requesting access for @luke and @sara. Link to request: https://pendo.request/123 :eyes:

raj: quick q — do we actually need full session replay? redaction + retention requirements. please add a data map and sampling policy.

emma: short answer: they said need clickstreams + occasional full sessions for drops in activation. I'll attach the data map in a sec.

vendor-onboarding-bot: New vendor access ticket created: VND-4721. Assigned to security. Steps: vendor review, DPA, config audit.

marta (security): If replay includes any free-text fields or URL params we must redact. Retention <= 90d. Access RBAC only. No public links. Also need vendor SOC2 + DPA.

emma: noted. What's our config block for Pendo to enforce redaction?

luke: paste sample config:

```

pendo:
  sessionReplay: true
  maskFields:
    - email
    - ssn
    - credit_card
  maskQueryParams: true
  retention_days: 90
  sampling_rate: 0.05

```

marta (security): ok add "maskTextRegex" for emails and phone numbers. Also disable third-party integrations for Pendo org. And make sure SSO + SCIM on.

raj: also require field-level hashing for user_id if sent, or use internal anonymous id mapping.

emma: we'll only send hashed user_id. I'll update ticket with data map + vendor docs. Can we get quick approval to proceed with limited access (no replay) while we finish DPA?

marta (security): provisional approval: grant read-only analytics (no session replay) to @luke,@sara for 2 weeks for experiment. No downloading raw session data. Audit logs enabled. :white_check_mark: 

luke: thanks. I'll configure and ping when done.

sara: adding checklist — SSO invite sent, SCIM pending.

vendor-onboarding-bot: Ticket VND-4721 updated: status = "provisioned-lite", note = "no-replay read-only access granted".

emma: thanks all :heart:
